syncSegmentsEn.text: Lord, I praise You
Because You chose me
Amid this vast sea of people
You were the one who sought me out
Lord, I praise You
Because You loved me
Your love fills the whole universe
It fills all the mountains and rivers
How many people Your love has saved
Your love has inspired us to live
Who would not bow down before You?
Who would not sing Your praise aloud?
O our great God
Our great God
It was You who lifted us up from the dust
You lifted us up from the dust
Words cannot tell the fullness of Your steadfast love
Songs cannot fully sing of Your righteousness
Across this vast earth
Who would not give You thanks and praise?
